feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 20 May 2026 10:16pm
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Wednesday, 20 May 2026 at 10:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Dry at first tonight, then rain and drizzle will develop after midnight. Temperature no lower than 11°C, with mainly moderate southwest winds.

Rain and drizzle at first tomorrow will soon die out, allowing warm sunshine to develop over northern and western parts. However, central and southern areas will stay cloudy and rather misty, with a few outbreaks of light drizzle remaining over the hills, and then a little light rain may develop more widely for a time later in the afternoon. Fresh southerly winds, with temperatures reaching 17°C in the north, then during the evening all parts of the island will become bright with late sunshine.


##Outlook##

Dry on Friday with sunny spells in places, especially in the north, but always a risk of mist and low cloud around central and southern coasts and hills.
